kind: Primary documentation check supporting bounded HOW; no runtime/product proof

sources.verified_semantics: NOWAIT errors immediately for conflicting selected row locks. It does not prevent the normal table-level ROW SHARE lock from waiting. No claim of universal nonblocking execution.
clock_timestamp gives actual current time, including changes during a statement; transaction_timestamp/now remain transaction-start values.

A cycle can involve row locks; PostgreSQL aborts a participant. Consistent ordering is preferred. The bounded proposal retains approved relative lock order and refuses selected conflicting row pins rather than waiting or automatically retrying provider dispatch.

limits: Actual code behavior remains subject to causal PostgreSQL tests. No generic analyzer change, new retry, lock-order waiver, or live system action authorized.
